title: An `element` carrying a property `v1` does not define
why: Nested objects are held to the same rule as the record, and this is the case its sibling misses: `schema-invalid-unknown-element-kind` is caught by the `kind` discriminant alone, so it says nothing about whether a *well-kinded* element may smuggle extra fields past the validator while the schema's `additionalProperties: false` rejects the same bytes.
